acceptance_criteria: The off-diagonal-disorder supplement independently generates theory density, ED density, and representative ALM/skin profiles.
The quasiperiodic supplement independently generates theory density, ED density, and representative ALM/skin profiles.
Both supplement examples use the published Hamiltonians and parameters while honestly capping fidelity where the paper omits exact state-selection windows or rendering metadata.
The OBC and PBC spectral densities overlap the finite-size exact-diagonalization histograms above the declared thresholds.
The essential-Lyapunov mobility contours and winding labels are generated from independent transfer-matrix numerics rather than source pixels.
The Fig. 5 alpha threshold remains near the paper's Wc ≈ 2.1 under the declared paper-matched configuration.
The one-way OBC Hamiltonian is constructed independently and its eigenvalue multiset equals the onsite-disorder samples to the declared tolerance.

The Fig. S3 runner implements arbitrary-precision dense ED and periodic-QR potentials for every published precision and energy; its paper-scale path is parameterized even when only the measured pilot is executed.
The Fig. S4 runner evaluates the published size grid and E0, then applies a predeclared seed/ensemble/QR sensitivity sweep without tuning to source pixels.

items.reason: Conceptual lattice and supercell construction diagram.
Illustrative localization profiles and sign cartoons, not independently generated numerics.
The OBC spectral density is independently regenerated from exact diagonalization at the paper's L=1000, 3200-realization scale.
Representative ALM, critical, and skin profiles are selected by independent numerical search rather than source-image tracing.
The Lyapunov density and essential-exponent mobility contour are generated from the transfer-matrix formulation with independent grids.
Potential convergence exponents are independently fit against system size using the documented paper-matched configuration.
The PBC spectral density is independently regenerated from exact diagonalization at the paper scale.
The PBC Lyapunov density and winding-sector labels are independently generated and cross-checked against direct twisted-boundary winding.
The mobility-edge contours for the five published disorder strengths are independently generated from the essential Lyapunov exponent.
The ALM-fraction curve and the Wc ≈ 2.1 threshold are independently regenerated from exact diagonalization plus Lyapunov classification.

The off-diagonal Hatano-Nelson theory density and mobility edge are independently generated from the published Hamiltonian. Because the paper does not publish its exact rendering grid, this item remains fidelity-capped rather than deferred.
The off-diagonal OBC spectral density is independently regenerated at reduced scale from exact diagonalization under the published parameters.
Representative ALM and skin profiles are selected by an independent Lyapunov-sign rule at reduced scale. The unpublished author windows cap fidelity but do not block scientific reproduction.
The quasiperiodic theory density and mobility edge are independently generated from the published Hatano-Nelson Hamiltonian with onsite modulation.
The quasiperiodic OBC spectral density is independently regenerated from exact diagonalization at reduced scale under the published model parameters.
Representative ALM and skin profiles are independently selected from the Lyapunov-classified quasiperiodic spectrum; the unpublished author windows cap fidelity but do not block reproduction.
The rho_OBC=rho_w limit is independently checked from the triangular OBC Hamiltonian and finite eigenvalue histograms.
